appleReference: https://www.apple.com/iphone-18-pro/; visually inspected and computed styles measured on 2026-10-14. SF Pro Display: hero 80/84px weight 600, section heading 48/52px weight 600. fonts: Bundled Oceanides Sans is an Inter derivative: Regular 400 optical size 14, Semibold 600 optical size 14, Display Semibold 600 optical size 32. Digit cmaps use Inter's own tabular glyphs for fixed advances in ReportLab. Family renamed; full original SIL OFL retained. Fonts embedded and snapshotted with every new revision. SF Pro is not used.
